anatomy.web: mic-selector.tsx builds a Popover around a Command: MicSelector (Popover plus a context holding devices, value, open and the trigger width), MicSelectorTrigger (an outline Button ending in a muted up-down chevron, watched by a ResizeObserver), MicSelectorContent (PopoverContent min-w-64 p-0 holding the Command), MicSelectorInput, MicSelectorList (render function over devices), MicSelectorEmpty, MicSelectorItem, MicSelectorLabel and MicSelectorValue.

api.web: MicSelector takes value, defaultValue, onValueChange, open, defaultOpen (false) and onOpenChange, plus Popover props. MicSelectorContent takes popoverOptions for the PopoverContent. states.web: MicSelectorValue shows the chosen device label or Select microphone... when none is chosen; the list shows MicSelectorEmpty (No microphone found.) when there are no devices or the search matches none. useAudioDevices tracks loading and error state, but no visual is drawn for them. MicSelectorLabel splits a trailing (vid:pid) into a muted suffix.

interaction.web: Opening the popover with no permission calls loadDevices, which asks for microphone access once so labels are filled in; the device list refreshes on the browser's devicechange event. Typing filters; choosing a MicSelectorItem sets the value to its device id and closes the popover. The content is as wide as the trigger but never narrower than min-w-64, so a bare chevron trigger does not draw a sliver.
